notes: Cleft 'he it is that': הוּא keeps its own 'he' and is not a home for the relative as well (rule 17); 'it is' and 'that' are two added units by office (rules 20, 55, 2). Competing readings named in the unit notes; a further alternative giving 'that' to הוּא as a doubled realization was considered and set aside since the ASV already writes 'he' for it.
